title: Testing Library: test the way the user uses it

videos.script:
Lesson 2's tests found the form by a class name and a field's name attribute. {{old}} A person finds it by what it says.

Testing Library finds things the way a person does. {{queries}} The button called Done. The field labelled Minutes. The heading that says Study planner. Rename a class, and these tests do not care.

They also read the page the way a screen reader reads it. {{label}} So when the rewritten test cannot find a field labelled Date, that is not the test being fussy. The field has no label. It has grey text that vanishes when you type.

You fix the form, and the test goes green without a line of it changing. {{green}}

Then two habits. {{user}} Type and click the way a person does, so a button nobody can press cannot pass. {{wait}} And wait for what arrives later, never for the clock.
